# AI-Worker

> AI-Worker is a free desktop AI agent that automates repetitive tasks entirely on your machine.
> Connect your daily tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and let AI-Worker handle your busywork — privately, with no data ever leaving your device.

## Product Summary

- **Name**: AI-Worker
- **Version**: 1.2 (Beta)
- **Category**: Productivity / Workflow Automation
- **Price**: Free (Early Access)
- **License**: Requires no account or credit card

## Key Capabilities

- Automate repetitive tasks without writing code
- Operate real desktop and web applications (click, type, read data)
- Connect tools via MCP: Google Drive, Slack, Calendar, databases, and more
- Private & local — all processing happens on your machine
- Self-healing automation engine — handles temporary errors and website changes automatically
- Supports autonomous multi-step agent execution

## Supported Platforms

- macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3 and Intel x86_64)
- Windows 10 / Windows 11 (x64)
- Linux (x86_64)

## Installation

### macOS (Terminal)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://downloads.ai-worker.tech/install-mac.sh | bash
```

### Linux (Terminal)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://downloads.ai-worker.tech/install-linux.sh | bash
```

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
irm https://downloads.ai-worker.tech/install-windows.ps1 | iex
```

## Use Cases

- Automate calendar scheduling and email management
- Summarise and organise Google Drive documents
- Perform autonomous research and reporting tasks
- Fill out repetitive web forms automatically
- Cross-application data entry and synchronisation

## Technical Details

- Uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool integration
- Browser automation powered by Playwright
- Runs as a native desktop application
- No cloud server required; operates fully offline

## About

AI-Worker is built for individuals and small teams who want to reclaim their time from repetitive, manual workflows. It acts as a private AI assistant that can see your screen, understand context, and take actions — like a skilled colleague who never gets tired.
